Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy.anatomy: gallbladder on the inferior surface of the liver (right upper quadrant); Hartmann's pouch; the cystic duct and cystic artery within Calot's (hepatocystic) triangle; the common bile duct and common hepatic duct; the liver bed / gallbladder fossa. Typical view: subhepatic, right upper quadrant.
Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy.fo_priors: Clip (applied to the cystic duct and cystic artery); Specimen bag (to extract the gallbladder); Specimen; Sponge; occasionally an External drain.

Sigmoid Resection.anatomy: sigmoid colon and descending colon; the rectum and rectosigmoid junction; the sigmoid mesocolon and its vessels; the inferior mesenteric artery and vein; the left ureter and gonadal vessels; the pelvic brim. Typical view: left lower quadrant and pelvis.
Sigmoid Resection.fo_priors: Clip; Sponge; External drain; Needle (from suturing/anastomosis); Specimen bag; Silicone loop.

Proctocolectomy.anatomy: the entire colon (ascending, transverse, descending, sigmoid), the rectum and anal canal; the terminal ileum (used for pouch formation); the mesocolon and mesentery; ileocolic and inferior mesenteric vessels. Typical view: across the abdomen and pelvis.
Proctocolectomy.fo_priors: Clip; Sponge; External drain; Needle; Specimen bag; Silicone loop.

Rectal Resection.anatomy: the rectum and its mesorectum; the sigmoid colon; the presacral space and pelvic floor; the inferior mesenteric artery; both ureters; the pelvic autonomic nerves. Typical view: deep pelvis.
Rectal Resection.fo_priors: Clip; Sponge; External drain; Needle; Specimen bag; Silicone loop.
